title_cyr: Давај ме мамо мори давај ме
title_latin: Davaj me mamo mori davaj me
title_en: Give me away, mother, hey, give me away
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Speaker roles are unclear; my reading is that a daughter asks to be given to the young man and the mother refuses. 'Женето' and the lines about the fourth child 'on his heart' are my reading.

lines.cyr: Давај ме мамо мори давај ме
lines.lat: Davaj me mamo mori davaj me
lines.en: Give me away, mother, hey, give me away
I can't, daughter, hey, I can't,
he is sick, the foolish young husband,

lines.cyr: пред седум, осум ќерко мори години.
lines.lat: pred sedum, osum ḱerko mori godini.
lines.en: since seven, eight years ago, daughter, hey.

lines.cyr: Три деца ќерко мори тој има
lines.lat: Tri deca ḱerko mori toj ima
lines.en: Three children, daughter, hey, he has,
and a fourth, daughter, hey, on his heart.
